programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes

programme.title: Naach Govinda Naach

programme.title: Action Time

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Ram Balram

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine
programme.desc: After Gopika and Kishan get married, she learns that her husband is a widower and has a child. She leaves him but later returns, asking him to accept her son from a previous relationship.

programme.title: Jaane Jigar
programme.desc: Two women look identical but hail from different backgrounds. They fall in love with Ravi and Vijay who are best friends. Misunderstandings arise when they believe they are in love with the same girl.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: Chalte Chalte
programme.desc: Geeta is admitted to a mental hospital after her lover passes away tragically. Later, she gains her senses, only to find him alive and in love with another woman.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: A street urchin is caught up in a scheming grand vizier's plot to get his clutches on a magical lamp. Retrieving the object from a wondrous cave, he releases a powerful genie trapped inside, whose ability to grant wishes helps the young hero thwart the villain's plans and woo a princess. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Robin Williams, Scott Weinger and Linda Larkin.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: Clownfish Nemo becomes separated from his friends on the Great Barrier Reef - but the thrill of being able to swim freely and away from his overprotective father turns to horror when he is netted by a diver. His distraught dad sets out on a mission to find him, while the youngster finds himself in a dentist's tropical tank. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: The Mighty Ducks
programme.desc: A self-centred yuppie lawyer is horrified when a judge finds him guilty of drink-driving and orders him to coach a hopeless inner-city junior ice-hockey team as part of his community service. However, he comes to appreciate his new role and things finally start to look up for the team. Comedy, starring Emilio Estevez, Joss Ackland, Lane Smith and Joshua Jackson.

programme.title: Bad Company
programme.desc: A secret agent is murdered, leaving his veteran CIA partner to transform the dead man's streetwise twin from an uncouth hustler into a credible replacement for his brother, so the agency can continue its investigation into a diabolical terrorist plot involving a nuclear bomb. Comedy thriller, starring Anthony Hopkins, Chris Rock, Peter Stormare, Gabriel Macht and John Slattery.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in wintry 1961 New York to visit his idol, Woody Guthrie, in self-imposed convalescence at Greystone Park Psychiatric Hospital. An impromptu acoustic performance of a song that Bob has written for Woody propels his star into the ascendancy. Oscar-nominated biopic, starring Timothee Chalamet.

programme.title: Aliens Vs Predator - Requiem
programme.desc: A spaceship crash results in the infestation of a small town by aliens, so a Predator is despatched to hunt them down - and any superfluous humans who happen to get in the way. However, an even bigger threat is lurking in the area, in the form of a terrifying hybrid of the two extraterrestrial creatures. Sci-fi action sequel, starring Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth and John Ortiz.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: The Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: Overworked estate agent Jim Evers takes his beleaguered family to look round an isolated, crumbling mansion - but the resident ghosts are not especially pleased to see the visitors. Comedy based on the Disney theme-park ride, starring Eddie Murphy, Terence Stamp, Jennifer Tilly and Marsha Thomason.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Cars 2
programme.desc: Racing car Lightning McQueen heads overseas to compete in an international grand prix, with events in Britain, Japan and Italy. He gets mixed up in international espionage when a case of mistaken identity leads to an encounter with two English spy cars searching for a powerful gadget. Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: Up
programme.desc: An old man attaches thousands of balloons to his house so he can fly it to South America, and fulfil his late wife's dream of exploring the jungle. However, once airborne, he finds he has an unwanted stowaway in the shape of an excitable boy scout. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Ed Asner, Jordan Nagai and Christopher Plummer.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: Well-meaning ant Flick lands his colony in trouble when he accidentally disposes of an offering meant for a swarm of greedy grasshoppers - who promptly promise a horrible revenge. Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

programme.title: Confessions of a Shopaholic
programme.desc: Aspiring fashion journalist Rebecca Bloomwood accepts a position writing for a financial magazine. As she sets the publishing world alight with her unique brand of consumer advice, Rebecca is forced to confront her own purchasing habits and begins to question whether rampant spending sprees are the way to true happiness. Comedy, starring Isla Fisher, Hugh Dancy, Krysten Ritter and Joan Cusack.

programme.title: The Fault in Our Stars
programme.desc: Indianapolis teenager Hazel has terminal thyroid cancer and attends a patients' support group, where she meets fellow teen Gus, who lost a leg to the disease. The two fall in love and a shared passion for books leads them on a literary pilgrimage to Amsterdam in search of reclusive author Peter van Houten. Romantic drama based on the bestselling novel by John Green, starring Shailene Woodley, Ansel Elgort, Laura Dern and Willem Dafoe.

programme.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol 2
programme.desc: After saving Xandar from Ronan's wrath, intergalactic outlaws Peter Quill (AKA Star-Lord), Gamora, Drax the Destroyer, Groot and Rocket Raccoon are recognised as heroes. Now, they must fight to stay together as they unravel the mystery surrounding Ego, a man who claims to be Quill's father. Writer/director James Gunn's follow up to his 2014 blockbuster, which reunites Chris Pratt, Zoe Saldana, Karen Gillan and Dave Bautista, with support from Kurt Russell, Sylvester Stallone and Pom Klementieff. Bradley Cooper also provides the voice of Rocket and Vin Diesel is Groot.

programme.title: Iron Man
programme.desc: Arms manufacturer Tony Stark is taken hostage by a terrorist group and realises the weapons his company build have been falling into the wrong hands. Using his engineering skills to construct a hi-tech armoured suit, he manages to escape and then puts the technology to good use in the fight against evil around the world. Superhero adventure, starring Robert Downey Jr, Jeff Bridges, Gwyneth Paltrow and Terrence Howard.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E17 — Isle of WightJames continues his British adventure by taking to the seas and travelling across the Solent to explore the Isle of Wight with Hampshire chef Lenny Carr-Roberts. James sets up at The Hut Café Colwell to cook up a dish of Isle of Wight prawns with tomatoes, mangalitza chorizo and pancetta. Lenny takes a trip to the other side of the island in search of James' favourite sausage roll, made by WW Woodford and Sons Butchers in Bembridge.

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers' Comfort Food
programme.desc: S1 E3 — A Taste of CumbriaDave enjoys a taste of his native county, Cumbria, as he and Simon cook recipes with great local ingredients. These include a comforting supper dish made from Cumberland sausage and the ultimate Cumbrian dessert, sticky toffee pudding.

programme.title: Delicious Miss Brown

programme.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Shrimp FestIt's shrimp season in Charleston, which is Kardea's favourite time of the year. She makes fried shrimp baskets, fries and a fresh grilled shrimp Cobb salad.

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
programme.desc: S1 E38 — Asian Fish and Ultimate Pork TacosAsian fish, miso noodles and crunchy veg, and ultimate pork tacos, spicy black beans and avocado garden salad.

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programme.desc: S4 E3 — Danny MeyerCulinary entrepreneur Danny Meyer joins Ina Garten at the barn for conversation, croissants and smoked salmon, and vanilla coffee shakerato. They dish over the restaurant trade before Danny prepares his orecchiette with broccoli rabe and sausage.

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programme.desc: S4 E2 — Nicole MannAstronaut Nicole Mann joins Ina Garten at the barn to share incredible stories from her time in orbit. Ina bakes an apple crostata and holds a masterclass in seared scallops with potato celery root purée.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S13 E5 — Dessert WeekIt's Dessert Week and the bakers get all steamed up in the Signature, tackle a classic lemon meringue pie in the Technical, and for the Showstopper are tasked with creating a sponge cake with a surprise inside.

programme.title: Rachel Allen: Bake!
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Baked Cheesecake/EclairsRachel shows us how to make a wonderfully rich blueberry cheesecake, and the students get to grips with choux pastry.

programme.desc: St Emilion: ReversionIn St Emilion James visits the kitchens where he worked as a lad more than 30 years ago.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S13 E9 — Deli Food ShowdownRee Drummond is testing recipes for her deli and having her friends pick which versions will end up on the menu. First, her basic chicken salad with grapes is up against a delicious curried chicken salad with raisins.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S13 E10 — Fixin' Fence, Fixin' LunchLadd and Cowboy Tim are out fixing fences, so Ree is fixing them their favourite Tex-Mex lunch! There's hearty rib eye quesadillas, spicy perfect pinto beans, taco ranch side salad and a frying-pan apple crisp.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S13 E11 — Well Done, DadRee celebrates her dad's retirement with a meal of all his favourite foods. There's slow-cooked Burgundy beef stew, creamy cheese grits casserole, super-tasty blistered green beans, and adorable mini chocolate-cherry Bundt cakes.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and desserts, each battling to produce smash hit dishes that wow their veteran. For her main, Lorna is confident her lamb dish `With A Little Help From My Friends', dedicated to supportive friends, is a celebratory dish fit for the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Emily's David Bowie inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes and she's using Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Joe has sourced his ingredients locally too, using hay from his family farm and Jersey beef.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E11 — Argentina v AlgeriaArgentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E9Adil Ray hosts as tennis coach Judy Murray and sports presenter Mark Pougatch take on Morning Live hosts Helen Skelton and Rav Wilding to win money for their chosen charities. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S1 E2Emotions run high as the family host their first public event, while Marnie explains the importance of animal husbandry as she cares for orphaned lamb Aga. Bruce the boar arrives on the farm to maximise the chances of pig-breeding success, and Kelvin and Liz roll up their sleeves as they renovate the farm cottage as a holiday rental to bring in extra income.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E12 — England v Croatia 17.06England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. These two teams last met at the European Championships held in 2021, with England winning a group stage encounter 1-0 at Wembley Stadium thanks to a second-half finish from Raheem Sterling. They also met in the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup in Russia, when Croatia came from behind to win 2-1 in extra-time and reach their first major final. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Ghana v PanamaGhana v Panama (Kick-off 12.00am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Toronto Stadium in Canada, as these two sides get their tournaments under way in their first-ever meeting. Ghana made it through to the finals after finishing top of CAF qualifying Group I, above the likes of Madagascar, Mali and Comoros after winning eight of their 10 matches. This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. With analysis from by Emma Hayes and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: All Elite Wrestling: Collision
programme.desc: S4 E25 — 16/06/2026Hard-hitting action, featuring stars including FTR, Thunder Rosa, Jon Moxley, Jay White, and Miro. With high-flying, hard-hitting, over-the-top action from some of the best wrestlers on the planet. Tony Schiavone, Kevin Kelly and Nigel McGuinness present.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Baton RougeThe travelling chef ventures into Louisiana's state capital Baton Rouge to experience a unique American phenomenon - tailgating. It's the day of a big football match at Louisiana State University, and the LSU Tigers are playing in front of thousands of fans. Surrounded by people barbecuing, cooking and sharing food from the back of their pick-up trucks, James joins in and cooks up a storm ahead of the game. He also takes time out to visit a Baton Rouge-based oyster restaurant specialising in North American varieties.

programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E11 — Argentina v AlgeriaArgentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.desc: S1 E2Emotions run high as the family host their first public event, while Marnie explains the importance of animal husbandry as she cares for orphaned lamb Aga. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E12 — England v Croatia 17.06England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. These two teams last met at the European Championships held in 2021, with England winning a group stage encounter 1-0 at Wembley Stadium thanks to a second-half finish from Raheem Sterling. They also met in the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup in Russia, when Croatia came from behind to win 2-1 in extra-time and reach their first major final. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Ghana v PanamaGhana v Panama (Kick-off 12.00am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Toronto Stadium in Canada, as these two sides get their tournaments under way in their first-ever meeting. Ghana made it through to the finals after finishing top of CAF qualifying Group I, above the likes of Madagascar, Mali and Comoros after winning eight of their 10 matches. This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. With analysis from by Emma Hayes and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: All Elite Wrestling: Collision
programme.desc: S4 E25 — 16/06/2026Hard-hitting action, featuring stars including FTR, Thunder Rosa, Jon Moxley, Jay White, and Miro. With high-flying, hard-hitting, over-the-top action from some of the best wrestlers on the planet. Tony Schiavone, Kevin Kelly and Nigel McGuinness present.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Baton RougeThe travelling chef ventures into Louisiana's state capital Baton Rouge to experience a unique American phenomenon - tailgating. It's the day of a big football match at Louisiana State University, and the LSU Tigers are playing in front of thousands of fans. Surrounded by people barbecuing, cooking and sharing food from the back of their pick-up trucks, James joins in and cooks up a storm ahead of the game. He also takes time out to visit a Baton Rouge-based oyster restaurant specialising in North American varieties.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E11 — Argentina v AlgeriaArgentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E12 — England v Croatia 17.06England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. These two teams last met at the European Championships held in 2021, with England winning a group stage encounter 1-0 at Wembley Stadium thanks to a second-half finish from Raheem Sterling. They also met in the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup in Russia, when Croatia came from behind to win 2-1 in extra-time and reach their first major final. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Ghana v PanamaGhana v Panama (Kick-off 12.00am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Toronto Stadium in Canada, as these two sides get their tournaments under way in their first-ever meeting. Ghana made it through to the finals after finishing top of CAF qualifying Group I, above the likes of Madagascar, Mali and Comoros after winning eight of their 10 matches. This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. With analysis from by Emma Hayes and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Ghana v PanamaGhana v Panama (Kick-off 12.00am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Toronto Stadium in Canada, as these two sides get their tournaments under way in their first-ever meeting. Ghana made it through to the finals after finishing top of CAF qualifying Group I, above the likes of Madagascar, Mali and Comoros after winning eight of their 10 matches. This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. With analysis from by Emma Hayes and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: All Elite Wrestling: Collision
programme.desc: S4 E25 — 16/06/2026Hard-hitting action, featuring stars including FTR, Thunder Rosa, Jon Moxley, Jay White, and Miro. With high-flying, hard-hitting, over-the-top action from some of the best wrestlers on the planet. Tony Schiavone, Kevin Kelly and Nigel McGuinness present.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Baton RougeThe travelling chef ventures into Louisiana's state capital Baton Rouge to experience a unique American phenomenon - tailgating. It's the day of a big football match at Louisiana State University, and the LSU Tigers are playing in front of thousands of fans. Surrounded by people barbecuing, cooking and sharing food from the back of their pick-up trucks, James joins in and cooks up a storm ahead of the game. He also takes time out to visit a Baton Rouge-based oyster restaurant specialising in North American varieties.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: S1 E1Part one of two. Investigating the murders of Carol and Stephen Baxter, a wealthy couple in their 60s who were found dead by their daughter on Mersea Island in Essex on Easter Sunday in 2023. With no sign of struggle and carbon monoxide poisoning ruled out, a mysterious will that leaves everything to their daughter and a family friend points police in a new direction.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral: The Mother and Daughter Killers
programme.desc: With access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary explores true crime cases linked to the social media platform. In the early hours of the 11th of February, 2022, two 21-year-old men - Saqib Hussain and Hashim Ijazuddin - were found dead in a burning car on the A46 in Leicestershire. Police soon arrested two unlikely culprits - 22-year-old TikTok influencer Mahek Bukhari and her 45-year-old mother Ansreen.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E11 — Argentina v AlgeriaArgentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E11 — Argentina v AlgeriaArgentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.desc: S2 E9Adil Ray hosts as tennis coach Judy Murray and sports presenter Mark Pougatch take on Morning Live hosts Helen Skelton and Rav Wilding to win money for their chosen charities. programme.desc: S1 E2Emotions run high as the family host their first public event, while Marnie explains the importance of animal husbandry as she cares for orphaned lamb Aga. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E12 — England v Croatia 17.06England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. These two teams last met at the European Championships held in 2021, with England winning a group stage encounter 1-0 at Wembley Stadium thanks to a second-half finish from Raheem Sterling. They also met in the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup in Russia, when Croatia came from behind to win 2-1 in extra-time and reach their first major final. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Ghana v PanamaGhana v Panama (Kick-off 12.00am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Toronto Stadium in Canada, as these two sides get their tournaments under way in their first-ever meeting. Ghana made it through to the finals after finishing top of CAF qualifying Group I, above the likes of Madagascar, Mali and Comoros after winning eight of their 10 matches. This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. With analysis from by Emma Hayes and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.desc: With access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary explores true crime cases linked to the social media platform. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E12 — England v Croatia 17.06England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. These two teams last met at the European Championships held in 2021, with England winning a group stage encounter 1-0 at Wembley Stadium thanks to a second-half finish from Raheem Sterling. They also met in the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup in Russia, when Croatia came from behind to win 2-1 in extra-time and reach their first major final. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Ghana v PanamaGhana v Panama (Kick-off 12.00am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Toronto Stadium in Canada, as these two sides get their tournaments under way in their first-ever meeting. This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: S1 E1Part one of two. With no sign of struggle and carbon monoxide poisoning ruled out, a mysterious will that leaves everything to their daughter and a family friend points police in a new direction.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral: The Mother and Daughter Killers
programme.desc: With access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary explores true crime cases linked to the social media platform. programme.title: Face to Face

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E11 — Argentina v AlgeriaArgentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E9Adil Ray hosts as tennis coach Judy Murray and sports presenter Mark Pougatch take on Morning Live hosts Helen Skelton and Rav Wilding to win money for their chosen charities. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S1 E2Emotions run high as the family host their first public event, while Marnie explains the importance of animal husbandry as she cares for orphaned lamb Aga. Bruce the boar arrives on the farm to maximise the chances of pig-breeding success, and Kelvin and Liz roll up their sleeves as they renovate the farm cottage as a holiday rental to bring in extra income.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: S1 E1Part one of two. With no sign of struggle and carbon monoxide poisoning ruled out, a mysterious will that leaves everything to their daughter and a family friend points police in a new direction.

programme.desc: With access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary explores true crime cases linked to the social media platform. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E11 — Argentina v AlgeriaArgentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Switzerland v Bosnia and HerzegovinaSwitzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina (Kick-off 8.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The Swiss won two of their three group matches in Qatar four years ago, overcoming both Cameroon and Serbia as they finished second to Brazil on account of their loss to the South Americans, but they then suffered a heavy 6-1 loss to Portugal in the last-16. The Bosnians failed to progress from the group stage at their only previous finals in Brazil in 2014, when a 3-1 victory over Iran in their final group game proved to be too little, too late after suffering losses to Argentina and Nigeria. This time around both teams have started their campaign with 1-1 draws, with the Swiss containing a late equaliser against the run of play to group underdogs Qatar, and their opponents sharing the spoils with co-hosts Canada. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v QatarCanada v Qatar (Kick-off 11.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group B match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, a 2022 friendly match in Vienna that saw just 150 people in attendance as Canada claimed a 2-0 victory. There will doubtless be many more to witness tonight's clash in an arena that boasts a capacity in excess of 54,000, with the vast majority of those supporting the co-hosts and aiming to inspire them to victory over a side that, like them, had never won a World Cup finals match prior to the commencement of this tournament. Canada also played a group match here in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup almost one year ago to the day and, on that occasion, they claimed a comprehensive 6-0 victory over Honduras. With analysis from Emma Hayes, Bradley Wright-Phillips and Ange Postecoglou, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: Episode 1: Defend & Attack - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: The season begins, and a new king reigns. But on the brutal icy roads of the legendary Rallye Monte-Carlo, legends and rivals are closing in. WRC More than Machine Season 2 is here!

programme.title: Episode 2: Now or Never - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: It's Now or Never! Rally Sweden’s icy roads and Safari Rally Kenya’s wild terrain push drivers to their limits. Rivals clash, teams strategise, and every second counts. Episode 2 now streaming!

programme.title: Episode 3: Vanishing Point - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: Toyota dominates early rallies, Hyundai fights for glory, and Neuville seeks redemption. Ogier's part-time run heats up the battle. Can the Manufacturers' Championship finally shift? EP3 now streaming!

programme.title: Episode 4: Resilience - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: With the new kid on the block Martins Sesks showing impressive pace, Adrien and Gregoire begin to feel the pressure as this rising star pushes them to the limits. In this episode of More than Machine, the talented 24-year-old and his teammates at M-Sport take on some of the most challenging stages of the season – Poland and Latvia.

programme.title: Episode 5: Cause and Effect - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: As M-Sport races towards the end of the season in Finland and Greece, tensions start to turn to securing drivers for next year. In episode five of More Than Machine, Adrien Fourmaux considers what it will take to be a world champion—and with which team.

programme.title: Episode 6: Let the Games Begin - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: With sights set on 2025, the M-Sport team tests their potential drivers for the upcoming season, determined to find their next leading contender. In episode six of More than Machine, step behind the scenes to see how M-Sport's young drivers strive to prove themselves at the crunch point of the season.

programme.title: Episode 7: Fortune Favours the Brave - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: With everything on the line, bold risks and fearless moves will give you the crown. The moment where legends are forged and history is made. Don’t miss the epic conclusion of More Than Machine S2!
